scope: unsigned private Mesa package built on an isolated Arch Linux ARM staging root; no M4 hardware validation
build_environment: aarch64 local VM; Arch Linux ARM overlay on an existing disposable test root; GCC 16.1.1, LLVM 23.1.4, Meson 1.12.1, makepkg 7.1.0
packaging: The second package release adds the detected lm_sensors runtime dependency and pins the LLVM 23.1, display-info 3 and sensors 5 library ABIs; the original compiled objects were reused after source checksums were reverified.
checks: makepkg produced an unsigned aarch64 package
the package BUILDINFO records the prepared PKGBUILD hash
the Vulkan library is ELF64 AArch64 and the driver manifests reference the private prefix
limitations: the staging root is not a clean target Omarchy installation
no target package transaction or UWSM session test
no M4 GPU, HDMI or recovery test
the library ABI pins may require rebuilding for a different Arch package set
